helpTitle: Three Card Rummy (the lower the total, the better)
helpBet: b <ante> [bonus]     place the ante (low bonus optional)
helpRebet: rb                   bet the same as last round
helpPlay: p / play             play — match the ante and see the dealer
helpFold: f / fold             fold and lose the ante
scoringNote: The three cards total as low as possible; 0 is best. Face cards are 10, an ace is 1. Three of a rank, or three in suit and sequence, count 0.
qualifyNote: The dealer qualifies on a total of 20 or less.
notQualifiedPayout: The ante pays and the play bet pushes
hintPlay: Play: your total is under the dealer's qualifying limit of 20
hintFold: Fold: 20 or more leaves you little to play for
